messages.content: Implement a Python function from a JSON behavioral card. The card is the only task specification. Return a JSON object with a single string field code containing executable Python source. Define solve with the card's exact signature. Use only Python's standard library. Allowed imports: math, itertools, functools, collections, heapq, bisect, statistics, fractions, operator, typing. Do not import or call NumPy, SymPy, NetworkX or any other third-party library. Do not read files, use network, introspection, eval, exec, input or print. Implement computations yourself using built-ins and the allowed standard library. Return plain JSON-compatible values, not iterators or sets; use string keys in dictionaries. Include any helper functions in the code. No tests or main block. Raise ValueError where the card requires it.

Implement this card:
{
  "algorithm": [
    "Construct a simple undirected graph from the input using vertex labels 0 to n-1",
    "Identify connected components of the graph",
    "For each connected component, find all edges that are not part of any cycle (bridges)",
    "Return bridges sorted lexicographically by (u, v) with u < v"
  ],
  "constraints": [
    "Vertices are labeled 0 to n-1",
    "Edges are distinct and satisfy 0<=u<v<n",
    "Graph must be simple (no self-loops or multi-edges)",
    "Bridges must be returned with u < v and lexicographically sorted"
  ],
  "edge_cases": [
    "Graph with no edges (all isolated vertices)",
    "Graph with a single edge (one bridge)",
    "Graph with multiple connected components",
    "Graph where all edges are bridges (no cycles)",
    "Graph with cycles (no bridges in cycles)"
  ],
  "inputs": "n: integer >= 1; edges: list of distinct [u,v] pairs with 0<=u<v<n",
  "method_id": "networkx.bridges",
  "output": "Sorted list of [u,v] pairs with u<v, lexicographically sorted, where u and v are string vertex keys",
  "purpose": "Generate all bridges in a simple undirected graph with isolated vertices",
  "signature": "solve(n, edges)"
}
